claim: An agent was asked how to get from the Ferry Building to the Golden Gate Bridge. Someone watching should believe DemoKit carried out the whole task on real Google Maps - typed both ends, saw the driving routes, then switched to walking and opened the turn-by-turn - and that every state it showed was the real map, not a mock.
_ledger: S0  Google Maps, directions, both boxes empty              <- where the viewer starts
S1  origin typed: Ferry Building                           <- type + Enter
S2  destination typed, driving routes drawn                <- type + Enter
S3  the same trip on foot, ~2 hours                        <- click Walking
S4  the walking turn-by-turn, step by step                 <- click Details

steps.label: type where we are
steps.shows: the origin resolving against Google's place index

steps.label: type where we are going
steps.shows: the destination, and the driving routes appearing

steps.label: on foot instead
steps.shows: the whole route re-drawn for walking - the better part of two hours

steps.label: show me every turn
steps.shows: the walking turn-by-turn, in order, with distances
